webhooks.detail: Webhooks via UI config and REST (POST /v2/webhooks creates a webhook subscription); events for conversations, tags, customers, satisfaction ratings.

evidence.quote: Webhooks enable Help Scout to call a script on your server when one or more events have happened.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox or developer account found in docs. API access depends on paid plan; any trial is on pricing pages, not confirmed.

evidence.quote: Your current rate limit depends on your plan.

rate_limits.summary: 200 req/min per account (plan-dependent); writes count as 2; 12 writes per 5s burst; 429 on throttle

evidence.quote: Write requests (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) count as 2 requests toward the rate limit.
